question: In a certain language the word CLOCK is written as 4 – 13 – 17 – 4 – 12. How will PHONE be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabet and their positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

Here is the logic followed:

CLOCK is written as 4 – 13 – 17 – 4 – 12.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e55d0d427d51c0fb1611d2d815cedc547a8278de4b71867cedb69f80c4890049.png] 

Similarly,

 PHONE is written as _____________

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa637f9bb272886e0c76c31cae41e195df8f581ed26f7162176c9411013e9a00.png] 

Therefore, the correct answer is " 17 - 9 - 17 - 15 - 6 ".
